headlines.title: Mondelēz brings UK protein bar Grenade to the US
headlines.summary: The Clif and Perfect Bar owner is doubling down on its domestic bar portfolio to leverage growing consumer demand for protein and portability.

headlines.title: Can Mondelez Build on 2.5% Growth in Biscuits and Baked Snacks?
headlines.summary: Mondelez's biscuits and baked snacks grow 2.5% in Q2 as volume/mix, brand gains and share trends strengthen, with innovation offering more growth levers.

headlines.title: Mondelez CEO Dirk Van De Put Sells 134,000 Shares for $8.5 Million
headlines.summary: Van De Put exercised stock options and immediately sold the shares under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted in May. His remaining direct holdings exceed $85 million.

headlines.title: Can Hershey step up to buy Mondelez?
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Hershey and Mondelez are more likely to expand partnerships in international markets than pursue a full-scale merger in the near term, Bernstein said, pointing to the success of their recent Reese’s and Oreo product collaborations.

headlines.title: Is Mondelez International (MDLZ) Worth More Than Its Price Suggests?
headlines.summary: Mondelez International stock has delivered a solid 19.6% return year to date, while a fresh Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate suggests the shares may still trade at a meaningful discount even though the broader valuation checks are cautious. Year to date, Mondelez International is up 19.6%, which puts recent gains front and centre for anyone thinking about new capital going into the stock.

description: Mondelez International, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and sells snack food and beverage products in Latin America, North America, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Europe. The company provides biscuits and baked snacks, including cookies, crackers, salted snacks, snack bars, and cakes and pastries; chocolates; and gums and candies, as well as various cheese, grocery, and powdered beverage products. Its brand portfolio includes Oreo, Ritz, LU, CLIF Bar, Tate's Bake Shop biscuits and baked snacks, Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka, and Toblerone chocolate. It serves supermarket chains, wholesalers, supercenters, club stores, mass merchandisers, distributors, convenience stores, gasoline stations, drug stores, value stores, and other retail food outlets through direct store delivery, company-owned and satellite warehouses, distribution centers, third-party distributors, and other facilities, as well as through independent sales offices and agents. The company also sells products directly to businesses and consumers through e-retail platforms, retailer digital platforms, as well as through its direct-to-consumer websites and social media platforms. Mondelez International, Inc. was formerly known as Kraft Foods Inc. and changed its name to Mondelez International, Inc. in October 2012. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
